## How hubs are built

- Generated by `scripts/build_role_hubs.py` from `data/role_scores.json`, `data/skills_ontology.json`, `data/project_archetypes.json` and `data/stack_model.json`, with ranks from `scripts/rank_roles.py`. Nothing on a hub is typed by hand.
- Every score keeps its evidence grade and basis; computed values (CCI, coverage, similarity) are Grade M; work footprints are Grade D.
